newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-C/A DEFICIT FALLS IN Q1 '97 VS Q4 '96.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-C/A DEFICIT FALLS IN Q1 '97 VS Q4 '96.

text.p: Estonia's current account deficit was 2.164 billion kroons in the first quarter of 1997 compared with 2.919 billion kroons in the fourth quarter of 1996, the central bank said on Thursday.
The overall balance of payments was 243.6 million kroons, the bank said in a statement.
The capital and financial accounts decreased in the first quarter of 1997 to 2.148 billion kroons compared to 3.607 billion kroons in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The reserves deficit decreased from 648.8 million kroons in the fouth quarter of 1996 to a deficit of 243 million kroons in first quarter 1997.
The trade deficit increased to 3.282 billion kroons compared to 3.115 billion kroons.
The trade balance in services increased to 1.569 billion kroons compared to 1.389 billion kroons.
